browser.mirror: Fireball replayed and native impact rendered

limitations: Historical source texture and mesh assets remain; modern native 3D models and higher resolution source textures were not available.
Spell presentation is improved against the videos but is not pixel-perfect with the current Clash Royale app.
Touchdown uses the supplied 551x647 stadium screenshot mapped to unchanged game geometry.
Headless browser timing is specific to this machine and workload.
